passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Amazon River is located in South America.
• It carries more water than any other river in the world.
• It flows into the Atlantic Ocean.
• Its drainage basin covers parts of nine countries.
stem: The student wants to identify the ocean into which the Amazon River flows. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: The Amazon River flows into the Atlantic Ocean.
The Amazon River is located in South America.
The Amazon carries more water than any other river.
The Amazon's basin covers parts of nine countries.
steps: The goal is to identify the ocean.
Only one note names an ocean: the Atlantic.
The other choices are true but give the continent, the volume of water or the size of the basin.
key: Read the goal first, then find the note that matches it exactly.
